Chapter 1086: 20: Long Time Passing (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 1086: Chapter 20: Long Time Passing (Subscription Request)_2

From nothing to something, these rules took form, revealing unprecedented perfection and… miracles in Lin Yuan’s eyes.

The birth of life is a miracle, and so is the evolution of the universe.

“Marvelous, marvelous, marvelous.”

Lin Yuan was entranced, fully immersed in it.

[Your insight is extraordinary, watching the destruction and rebirth of the universe, your understanding of the essence of the Great Dao rules is enhanced…]

Every moment, Lin Yuan’s mind burst with countless insights and inspirations.

The Chaos Void Origin rules operated, nurturing one universe after another, these universes underwent destruction and rebirth, which were manifestations of the Chaos Void Origin rules.

However, such a manifestation is hard to glimpse below the level of a Great Saint.

To set up something like the Xuanhuang Secret Realm within a universe, at least the strength of a Chaos Great Saint is required, and even most Chaos Great Saints cannot achieve it.

“Now this universe is still in the process of being reborn, and once it fully begins its new life, with countless rules and paths restarting, and life gradually reviving, it should have the greatest impact on me.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“By then, having witnessed the entire process from the universe’s destruction to rebirth, my comprehension of the rules will surely soar dramatically, possibly reaching the level where I can effortlessly create a universe.”

Lin Yuan secretly thought.

A twelfth-layer life form’s inner world transforms into an inner universe, but this inner universe is nurtured slowly from weak to strong by a twelfth-layer life form.

It’s still far from effortlessly creating a universe.

In Chaos Void, forces of the Revered level typically establish their own Chaos Continents.

But forces of the Great Saint level, especially those top-tier forces with formidable Great Saints, often create a universe specifically.

Such a universe is not nurtured by the Chaos Void, so it lacks the indelible characteristics, yet it has unparalleled advantages in size and in nurturing life’s degree compared to a Chaos Continent.

Universes specifically created by exceptional Great Saints can set rules to a certain extent, such as forming certain special training environments or nurturing specific life forms, and so on.

“Effortlessly creating a universe… this also reflects reaching the pinnacle of rule comprehension.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, if one has not comprehended countless rules, how could they easily create a complete universe?

“Unfortunately, this universe at present still has some time before it enters the rebirth phase, much longer than the normal time for a universe to transition from great destruction to rebirth. Is it because I took away too much life during the great destruction, leading to insufficient momentum for rebirth, thus needing time to absorb the power of the Chaos Void?”

Lin Yuan muttered to himself.

In fact, Lin Yuan speculated that there might be more reasons than just this.

Also, he absorbed a large amount of World-Breaking Origin Force during the universe’s great destruction?

Although up to now, Lin Yuan still does not know the essence of the World-Breaking Origin Force, it is definitely a form of extremely advanced power.

During the universe’s great destruction, such source power dissipates, but it ultimately only dissipates within the universe and eventually merges back into the universe. Yet during this universe’s great destruction, it was all absorbed by him.

“Unfortunately… only life forms within the universe can access this method of absorbing the World-Breaking Origin Force.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

In recent years, he occasionally sent avatars to explore the nearby Void Domain and had discovered universes undergoing destruction, but he couldn’t absorb any extra World-Breaking Origin Force.

…

‘Starlight Tear’ Fragment World.

A period has passed since human civilization migrated here.

In a classroom full of high-tech atmosphere, more than a dozen students were attentively listening to the teacher’s lecture on stage.

In fact, with the current technology of human civilization, education could have been fully conducted in the Virtual World long ago, but some schools still retain this way of face-to-face teaching in reality.

Compared to the Virtual World, reality always feels more authentic.

The teacher standing on the podium was a middle-aged woman. She looked at the many students below. These students were all born in the last ten years or so, born in this fragment world, nurtured by the Starlight Tear, possessing great innate talent and potential, nearly all destined to become evolvers in the future.

“Sun Ming.”

The middle-aged woman frowned, gazing at a student sitting towards the back. This student seemed slightly dazed, clearly lost in thought.

“I’m here, teacher.”

The student named Sun Ming quickly reacted, hurriedly stood up, and said.

“Why don’t you tell us what the Galaxy Calendar is.”

The middle-aged woman smiled as she looked at him.

“The Galaxy Calendar?”

Sun Ming’s spirits lifted, if asked about knowledge from some other area he might not know, but the Galaxy Calendar? Who wouldn’t know he was a devoted fan of the Galaxy’s greatest hero?

“Fifty-six years ago, the universe in which we lived faced destruction, and countless citizens of our human civilization would have perished along with the universe if nothing else happened.”

“But the Galaxy’s greatest hero stood up, single-handedly taking all our human civilization’s citizens out and eventually migrating to this new homeland.”

“From that time on, the old calendar of human civilization, the ‘Starry Sea Era,’ ended, and the first year of the ‘Galaxy Calendar’ began.”

“The so-called ‘Galaxy Calendar’ is named after the Galaxy’s greatest hero, to commemorate the Galaxy’s greatest hero’s monumental achievements.”

Sun Ming answered with great enthusiasm.

The other students listened with equal excitement.

In human civilization, the image of the Galaxy’s greatest hero has almost reached the level of deification.

“Very good, very good.”

The middle-aged woman nodded slightly.

Perhaps the new humans born in this new homeland cannot understand it, but she?
